wide_pattern: working/navigation pane plus canonical communication/evidence pane when content container >=1040px
narrow_pattern: labelled pane switcher preserves Work and Communications/evidence states; switching does not discard either context
objective_rule: Objective/Task surfaces preserve source plan, accepted operational Task plan, derived Objective envelope and execution as visibly distinct facts
communication_rule: LLD-09 owns canonical message/link/coverage data; LLD-10 must not copy body/participant authority into ticket state; terminal summary has no body navigation after content unavailable
action_rule: availability/blocker/remediation derives from owning-domain projection; predictable invalid actions are not enabled merely to fail
working_copy_rule: tab/pane changes preserve dirty UI copy; accepted save only through owning-domain command; domain Draft badges are accepted state and visually distinct from dirty markers
